in_hebrew.name: Cletus
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Glory of the Moon
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Cletus הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'kleos', meaning 'glory', and 'selene', the name of the Greek goddess of the moon. In Christian tradition, Cletus is known as a disciple of St. Peter and a bishop in ancient Rome.

in_greek.name: Cletus
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Glory of the Moon
in_greek.long_meaning: Cletus είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Greek word 'kleos', meaning 'glory', and 'selene', the name of the Greek goddess of the moon. In Christian tradition, Cletus is known as a disciple of St. Peter and a bishop in ancient Rome.
